question: The headquarters of West Central Railway Zone of Indian Railway is located in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __Jabalpur.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The West Central Railway has** its headquarters at **Jabalpur.**
 
• The zone** **comprises of **Jabalpur and Bhopal divisions** of erstwhile Central Railway and **Kota division** of erstwhile Western Railway.
 
• It has total route kilometers of** 2997 km**. (Track kilometres-6295 km.) of which 1627 route km. are electrified.
 
• The Present Railway Minister is **Mr. Ashwini Vaishnav (As of Oct 2021).**
